read_file.description: Read a UTF-8 text file inside a directory authorized for this session or a bound skill directory. Returns the file with 1-based line numbers.

parameters.path: Relative to this session's default directory, or absolute inside an authorized or bound skill directory

write_file.description: Write a UTF-8 text file inside a directory authorized for this session, creating or replacing it.

parameters.path: Relative to this session's default directory, or absolute inside an authorized directory

edit_file.description: Replace an exact text snippet in a file inside a directory authorized for this session. The old text must appear exactly once unless replaceAll is set.

parameters.path: Relative to this session's default directory, or absolute inside an authorized directory

run_shell.description: Run a shell command with this session's default directory. Returns bounded combined stdout/stderr (the tail when it exceeds the limit) while also streaming output during the run; when the limit is exceeded, the complete output is written to a temporary file whose path is reported. A long-running command is stopped at timeoutMs (milliseconds).

parameters.cwd: Directory to run in; defaults to this session's authorized default directory

load_skill.description: Read the full SKILL.md of one of your bound skills, by name.

send_message.description: Send an in-app message. Provide exactly one of `to` (a direct message to another employee) or `roomId` (a channel of the current work you are a member of). In a channel, only the `recipientIds` and `mentionAll` fields decide who is woken: omit them and no employee is woken. Mentions, names, and @all inside `body` are message text only and never select recipients. Your own message never wakes you. For an ordinary reply to the current conversation, return final text instead; Emit posts it automatically. If an unaddressed current-channel message has already been sent, the final summary stays in the execution record.

parameters.to: Employee name, id, or address; opens or reuses your direct conversation with them
parameters.roomId: Channel id; for the channel this work runs in, take the exact id from the current-channel context section, never the work ID or the channel name
parameters.body: Message content only; text never selects recipients or wakes employees.
parameters.recipientIds: Explicit employee ids to wake, taken from the employee directory in your context where member=true and enabled=true; omitting the field wakes nobody
parameters.mentionAll: Explicitly wake every enabled channel member except yourself (default false); do not set this merely because the message text contains @all

invite_to_channel.description: Add employees to the channel this work runs in. Inviting changes membership; it is not a member query, takes effect immediately, and never wakes the invited employee; address them explicitly afterwards to start their work.

parameters.employeeIds: Employee ids to add, taken from the employee directory in your context (not names or addresses); at most 20 at once

list_work_notes.description: List the shared notes of the current work: title, id, author, and update time, plus the current work version. Bodies are read with read_work_note.

read_work_note.description: Read one shared note of the current work by id. A note of a different work is never readable.

save_work_note.description: Create or update a shared note of the current work. Only save when the user asked you to share something, or when handing work over explicitly; never auto-save a private conversation. Pass the work version as expectedVersion; on a version conflict, read again and retry instead of overwriting.

parameters.title: Short note title
parameters.noteId: Existing note to update; omit to create
parameters.expectedVersion: The work version from list_work_notes or your context

send_mail.description: Send an in-app mail to another employee. It starts their work and their reply arrives as a mail. Set awaitReply=true when this task cannot be finished without the other employee's result: after doing everything else the current run is paused, and the reply continues it, so the final answer must not be written before the reply is read. Leave awaitReply=false for notices and independent mails; their answers only land in the mailbox.

parameters.subject: Mail subject
parameters.newSession: Start an independent session with no inherited directories
parameters.inReplyTo: Sent mail entry in the current session to branch from
parameters.awaitReply: Wait for this employee's reply and continue this task with it (default false)

delegate_task.description: Hand a task to another employee and let them own it. Their result comes back to you as a message in this conversation.

parameters.task: What to do, and what to return
